source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 3 同主题完形(绿色日记/小镇回收/碳排放图表/植树日/家庭节水/烟雾访谈)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: My Green Week
passages.text: This week our class started a project to live in a greener (1)____. Each of us promised to do small things to protect the (2)____. On Monday I turned off every (3)____ before leaving the room, and I unplugged the computer instead of leaving it on standby. On Tuesday I carried a cloth bag to the shop so that I did not need a (4)____ one. On Wednesday I rode my (5)____ to school instead of asking my dad to drive me, which gave off less carbon dioxide. On Thursday I learned to (6)____ our rubbish into paper, glass and metal so that it could be reused. On Friday I took a shorter shower to (7)____ water. By the end of the week, I felt (8)____ of these new habits. None of them was (9)____, yet together they really helped to cut my carbon (10)____. I plan to keep them up for the rest of the year.

passages.title: A Town That Recycles
passages.text: Greenfield used to be a town with a serious (1)____ problem. Rubbish was left in the streets, and dirty water was poured into the river. The local (2)____ decided that something had to be done. First, they made strict (3)____ about how waste should be handled. Factories that broke the rules had to pay a heavy (6)____. The government also began regular (7)____ to make sure the rules were followed. Slowly the air and water grew much (8)____. Today Greenfield is a clean and (9)____ town, and other places come to learn from it. The mayor often says that everyone, from children to old people, helped to (10)____ the beauty of their home.

passages.title: Reading the Carbon Graph
passages.text: In science class our teacher showed us a (1)____ about carbon dioxide in the air. The line on it went up year after year, which was a worrying (2)____. She explained that most of this gas comes from burning (3)____ fuels such as coal and oil. When we drive cars or run factories, we (4)____ carbon dioxide into the sky. This gas traps (5)____ around the earth, so the planet slowly gets (6)____. As a result, the ice at the poles begins to (7)____, and the level of the sea rises. The teacher said that this is now a (8)____ problem that affects every country. But she also gave us (9)____. If people use clean energy and cut their carbon (10)____, the line on the graph can start to fall again. We left the class knowing that our daily choices really matter.

passages.title: Tree-Planting Day
passages.text: Last Saturday our whole school joined a tree-planting (1)____ on a bare hillside. The land there was dry and (2)____, because too many trees had been cut down in the past. Our teacher told us that young trees would help to hold the (3)____ and keep water in the ground. Each group was given a few small trees to (4)____. At first the work was (5)____, and my hands soon hurt from digging. But nobody wanted to give (6)____. We dug holes, placed the trees in carefully, and gave each one plenty of (7)____. By noon the empty hill was dotted with rows of green. Our teacher said that in many years these trees would grow into a small (8)____ that cleaned the air. She reminded us that protecting (9)____ is the duty of everyone. As we walked home, tired but happy, I felt proud that we had done something to (10)____ the land.

passages.title: Saving Water at Home
passages.text: My grandmother grew up in a village where clean water was hard to (1)____, so she taught me never to (2)____ a single drop. My father even fixed the old tap that used to (8)____ slowly all night. Grandmother says that water is too (9)____ to throw away, and that careful use today will help our whole town in the future. passages.title: An Interview about Smog
passages.text: Last week a radio host (1)____ an expert about the smog that sometimes covers big cities. The expert explained that smog is a kind of dirty (2)____ formed when smoke mixes with fog.
